text:
Priya G: Quick sync — where are we on Edgewise private rollout for acme-corp? Milestone A (network signed) due EOD Thu.
Tom H: Net owner's update: spoke with NetOps, waiting on customer egress ASN. Pending from acme side.
Mira Chen: FYI, infra image sync to airgapped registry queued — need registry cert from acme via SFTP by tomorrow.
Sam B: Can infra team confirm firewall port list? I forwarded the minimal ports in latest runbook.
Linh Tran: I can own cluster-facing firewall rules once Tom confirms NAT addresses. @Tom H please paste.
Tom H: NATs: 10.200.5.0/28 (primary), 10.200.5.16/28 (failover). Confirmed with NetOps.
Mira Chen: Also acme requested HSM/KMS integration — checklist item. @Priya G do we need legal sign-off before HSM key export?
Priya G: Legal said we can proceed with KMS integration, but customer needs to sign the export waiver. I'll ping sales.
deploy-bot: [deploy-log] image-sync job 721 failed on cert verify: CA mismatch.
Sam B: /cc @Mira Chen — the CA mismatch is likely missing intermediate. Can you share the cert bundle? If not, we need to get it from customer.
Mira Chen: Upload incoming now to sftp://acme/keys, filename acme-ca-bundle.pem
Tom H: One blocker: airgap registry handshake requires HTTP(S) egress on port 443 to our cert fetcher; customer said "no outbound". We need alternative.
Linh Tran: Alternative: bring the cert bundle via transfer media and use registry offline import flow. I wrote script:
```
# offline import
redwood-registry import --bundle acme-ca-bundle.pem --images images.tar.gz
```
Priya G: Is someone able to execute the offline import at the customer's datacenter on Friday? We need an owner.
Sam B: I can travel Friday morning and execute import, but need runbook steps confirmed and ops access.
Tom H: I'll add NAT rules to runbook and hand off to Sam. @Sam B I'll share SSH keys and service account.
Mira Chen: Quick QA: will the offline import preserve image signatures? We should preserve cosign annotations.
Linh Tran: Yes, the tool preserves signatures as long as --preserve-sigs flag used.
Sam B: Got it. @Priya G can you confirm approval for travel expense? :money_with_wings:
Priya G: Approved. Please file Travel request and expense with Ops before EOD.
Tom H: Action items summary (I'll paste):
- NetOps: confirm ASN + NATs (done)
- Priya: get export waiver from customer
- Mira: transfer cert bundle to SFTP (in progress)
- Linh: provide offline import script + runbook (done)
- Sam: execute import Friday + validate images (owner)
- Security: validate KMS/HSM integration after import
Sam B: I'll also run basic smoke: model load, small gen, token latency under 120ms.
Priya G: Thanks folks — if any blockers surface drop a message here. We'll do async checkin 10:00am PT tomorrow.
Tom H: noted
Mira Chen: thanks
deploy-bot: [reminder] async check-in scheduled 1718590721
